description: This file contains a PHP class defining an OpenCart extension controller for the 'shipping' total module within the admin panel. It includes methods for rendering the shipping total configuration page and saving configuration settings.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class for managing the shipping total extension in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the shipping total extension settings page in the admin interface.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the shipping total extension via AJAX.
